summary.text: Blake Johnson is a Democratic member of the Indiana House representing District 100 in Central Indiana, selected on June 27, 2020, to fill a vacancy.
The caucus page lists Johnson as ranking Democrat on the Rules and Legislative Procedures Committee and the Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Johnson previously served on the Indianapolis City-County Council, where he chaired the Administration and Finance Committee and, according to the page, led more than $1 billion in capital investment across his district.
He was selected by Mayor Joe Hogsett to help lead an education task force that produced the city's Indy Achieves Scholarship Program.
As a legislator, Johnson has focused on transit, educational attainment and talent initiatives, according to the page.

The page says he serves as interim CEO of The Parks Alliance of Indianapolis and owns a small strategic consulting firm, and that he lives near downtown Indianapolis with his wife, Natalie, and their sons.
